Responsive options for highcharter objects

Source: R/highcharts-api.R
hc_responsive.Rd

Allows setting a set of rules to apply for different screen or chart sizes. Each rule specifies additional chart options.

Usage

hc_responsive(hc, ...)

Arguments

hc

A highchart htmlwidget object.

...

Options defined in https://api.highcharts.com/highcharts/responsive.

Examples

# At 450 px the legend is hidden. At 950 px it appears on the right.
highcharts_demo() |>
  hc_responsive(
    rules = list(
      list(
        condition = list(maxWidth = 500),
        chartOptions = list(legend = list(enabled = FALSE))
      ),
      list(
        condition = list(minWidth = 900),
        chartOptions = list(
          legend = list(
            align = "right",
            verticalAlign = "middle",
            layout = "vertical"
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
